{{Infobox Slayer |name = Monkeys |skillreq = None |combatreq = None |otherreq = None |turael = 15-30 |spria = 15-30 |id = No }} [[Monkey|Monkeys]] can be assigned as a slayer task by [[Turael]] and [[Spria]]. There is no [[combat]] or [[slayer]] requirement needed to be assigned monkeys. Monkeys are commonly found in tropical areas throughout [[Gielinor]]. [[Monkey (monster)|Regular monkeys]] are most commonly killed to complete this task. However, there are high level alternatives locked behind [[Monkey Madness I]] and [[Monkey Madness II]], namely [[Monkey Archer]]s, [[Monkey Guard]]s, [[Monkey Zombie]]s, [[Tortured gorilla]]s,
